gaps.title: No runtime PnL range guard (assertFits equivalent)
gaps.closure_criteria: Guard implemented or owner-waived. Implemented 2026-10-04 (AC-13): legacy PnlCalculator::assertFits port - computePnl returns an explicit out-of-range result kind (netPnl 16 integer/8 fraction digits, rMultiple 10/8 - the legacy limits, stricter than the modern NUMERIC(20,2)/(20,8) columns so schema fit is guaranteed); tradeService maps it to the legacy error vocabulary (422 VALIDATION_FAILED, code OUT_OF_RANGE, messageKey errors.validation.range, field profitLoss/rMultiple) at both call sites (create + exit recompute). Verified: domain 17/17 incl. 6 boundary tests (16-digit pass / 17-digit reject, negative, shadowing order, 10-digit r pass / 11-digit reject); service 28/28 incl. 3 integration tests; full battery ALL PASS; typecheck 0 errors; secret-scan 0 findings. Mechanism divergence (deliberate, documented): result kind instead of throw, per ADR-001 §5 house style - the audit itself notes modern 'makes the branch explicit'.

OBSERVATION (verified against the executed legacy PHP itself): the legacy header's round-trip claim '1925..2124 / jy 1304..1503' is INACCURATE - the measured clean windows are gregorian-first 2000..2100 (every day) and jalali-first jy 1379..1478 except Esfand-30 of the 9 in-window leap years; outside them the legacy pair drifts (e.g. 1925-01-01 -> 1303/10/11 -> 1924-12-31). The port preserves legacy behavior verbatim (parity over correction); out-of-window drift is pinned by tests so any future algorithm change is loud; correcting the algorithm is an owner decision. EST/offset rejection). 19/19 tests (legacy vectors S1-S21) PLUS a direct cross-check: the ACTUAL legacy PHP classes and the modern port produce IDENTICAL output on all 14 classification vectors (summer/winter DST, boundaries, cross-midnight, weekday filter). REMAINING: achievements engine port.

Evidence: pre-fix crash reproduced (process exit 1); post-fix, a malformed job is DLQed with the process alive AND the real timekeeper fired the analytics tick end-to-end on disposable PG 17.11 (scheduler.analytics_tick count=1 -> job.done analytics.recompute-tick -> analytics.recomputed count=1 -> job.done analytics.recompute-daily; user_analytics_daily row materialized).
